title: No explicit non-degenerate (separating) model is ever exhibited

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** Remark after Def `def:matrix` (only the one-element degenerate matrix $A=D=\{*\}$ is given); whole Completeness section (only the canonical matrix, whose non-degeneracy is unproved).

**Gap.** A faithful answer to 'exhibit a class of structures with respect to which NL is sound and complete' should include at least one **concrete non-degenerate** structure certifying that the axioms are non-trivially satisfiable. The attempt exhibits only (i) the degenerate one-element matrix (validates everything) and (ii) the Lindenbaum–Tarski matrix (non-degenerate only if NL is consistent — see related issue). No connective table / frame where $\bar v(B1),\bar v(B2),\bar v(A9),\bar v(A10)$ are all designated while some formula is not is produced.

**Why hard.** Connexive $\to$ must be non-monotone yet validate contraposition + both Boethius theses; the attempt notes no small lattice-ordered transitive model works, so a genuine separating model needs a larger / twist-structure / non-monotone implication.

**What is required.** Provide an explicit finite matrix or finite relational frame (e.g. a Nelson twist-structure $A\times A$ with $\neg(a,b)=(b,a)$ and a relevant $\to$, or a small Routley–Meyer frame) verified by direct computation to designate all axioms while refuting some formula. This simultaneously settles consistency (related issue) and supplies a genuine semantics (related issue).
